style: Calm, premium, confident. Typographic minimalism on a deep blue-black field: a single all-caps letterspaced lockup, cinematic blur-to-sharp emergence, one hairline-rule accent; no photos or stock visuals; subtle vignette acceptable. Dark-bg optical compensation applies (light-on-dark reads heavier; add slight letter-spacing).
brief: Over a deep blue-black field, ALLIANCE TECHNICAL GROUP materializes as one letterspaced all-caps line: a cinematic fade_blur entrance (opacity+blur, whisper of per-word stagger) whose first glimmer lands on the 0.5s beat, readable by ~2.0s, letter-spacing settling 0.30em to 0.22em by 2.6s; the lockup then holds with a barely perceptible hold_breath swell while the ambient bed plays low underneath; the single pattern-interrupt lands on the 5.0s beat - a gradient hairline sweeps beneath the name (underline_sweep, anticipated at 4.9s) with a faint glow lift on ALLIANCE - and on the 8.8s beat type, rule, and music resolve together in a quiet fade, resting on the empty dark field at 10.0s exactly. Dominant motion idea: emergence-into-focus, one continuous blur-to-sharp fade-and-settle; the music is a bed, not a beat-grid driver - beats (seconds) are gentle accents only. Part 2 design decisions (headless, autonomous): hand-author the lockup per the kinetic-type module else-path - none of the 18 caption-* catalog blocks cover a 10s single-lockup cinematic emergence (they are word-sequence caption engines; the nearest in mood, caption-editorial-emphasis, would need its entrance/timing wholly replaced), so content.block is null and reuse is applied where blocks genuinely fit: polish blocks vignette (0.25) + grain-overlay (0.05, anti-banding on the near-black field); emphasis on ALLIANCE expressed as weight contrast (600 vs 300) inside the single line, not color; BGM assets/bgm/track.wav is resolved (30.0s WAV landed, first 10s used) and mixed at base volume 0.55 - overriding audio_meta.json's 0.9 default because the user asked for SUBTLE - with a 0.8s fade-in and a fade-out from 8.6s (0.2s ahead of the visual beat so the audio decay lands with the type fade), silent by 9.9s. Part 1 decisions retained: kinetic-type over logo-reveal (no logo asset; purely typographic dark treatment), 1920x1080 @ 30fps for 10.0s in English per BRIEF.md, Montserrat from the HF embed list, title-case source copy 'Alliance Technical Group' rendered uppercase.

asset_needs.query: subtle ambient minimal music bed, calm premium confident, soft pads, no drums
asset_needs.notes: Background bed only, mixed low under an unnarrated title piece; ~10s usable length (loop or trim with fades is fine); subtle/ambient/minimal mood; NOT a beat-grid driver, so avoid hard rhythmic hits; gentle fade-out at the tail to land with the closing fade.
asset_needs.resolved_notes: MusicGen local generation complete: 30.0s mono 16-bit PCM WAV @ 32kHz (12s seed crossfade-looped x3), subtle dark ambient pads, no drums. Only the first 10.0s are used. Mix per content.customize.audio (base 0.55 with fades), overriding audio_meta.json's 0.9 default.

build.why_no_caption_block: The 18 caption-* blocks are word-sequence caption engines (slam / glitch / karaoke / decode...); none cover a 10s single-lockup blur-to-sharp emergence with tracking settle, a ~6s breathing hold, and a synchronized audio+visual resolve. Nearest-mood caption-editorial-emphasis would need its entrance, timing, and motion wholly replaced - costlier and riskier than the module's compact hand-author recipe.
build.recipe: Per kinetic-type module: one full-duration .clip (data-start 0, data-duration 10); one flex-centered .group; words as spans; explicit gsap.fromTo() entrances per the motion spec; seek-safe autoAlpha only on inner non-clip elements; single paused timeline registered on window.__timelines; GSAP default adapter; deterministic only. Honor references/builder-contract.md.

polish_blocks.note: style spec allows 'subtle vignette'; keep barely-there
very low film grain to prevent gradient banding on the near-black field in mp4; drop if npm run check flags noise/contrast

layout.lockup_anchor: centered at x 50%, y 47% (optical center, ~507px from top)

lockup.fit_rule: Builder may adjust size +/-10% so the SETTLED lockup width fits <= 1660px safe width; the wider 0.30em entrance state may transiently reach ~1790px but must never clip the 1920px frame
lockup.hierarchy_note: Emphasis via weight contrast only (600 vs 300) and full vs 0.85 ink opacity - no color change, single line, one lockup

field.radial_lift: radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 48% at 50% 47%, #131A24 0%, rgba(19,26,36,0) 62%) at opacity 0.35 - a barely perceptible depth pool behind the lockup; static (no animation)
field.note: No photos, no stock; the field is color + vignette + grain only

underline.width: 60% of the settled lockup width, horizontally centered under it
underline.motion: underline_sweep: scaleX 0 -> 1, transformOrigin left center, start 4.90s, duration 0.90s, ease power3.out (onset anticipates the 5.0s beat by 0.1s; full extension at 5.80s)
underline.exit: fades with the lockup in the 8.8s fade_out

phases.design: Field, vignette, grain visible from frame 0. Lockup entrance: per-word fade_blur (opacity 0->1, blur 14px->0), word starts 0.30 / 0.40 / 0.50s, each 1.9s, ease power2.out - first glimmer perceptible on the 0.5s beat, readable by ~2.0s, fully sharp by 2.40s. Letter-spacing settles 0.30em -> 0.22em over 0.30-2.60s, ease power3.out.

hold_breath on the lockup group: scale 1 -> 1.015 over 2.6-8.8s, ease sine.inOut (one slow swell). Pattern-interrupt (the one change) on the 5.0s beat: underline_sweep per customize.underline + faint glow on ALLIANCE - textShadow '0 0 32px rgba(143,168,200,0.55)', 0.8s out + 0.8s back (yoyo), 5.0-6.6s. Legibility hold: sharp and static-readable 2.6-8.8s (6.2s >= 0.3s minimum).

On the 8.8s beat: fade_out - lockup + underline opacity -> 0 over 8.8-9.9s, ease power2.in. Frame rests on the empty dark field (bg + vignette + grain remain) until 10.0s exactly. Audio is already decaying (started 8.6s) and is silent by 9.9s, so picture and sound land together.

audio.volume_note: OVERRIDES audio_meta.json's default 0.9 - the user asked for SUBTLE music under an unnarrated title; mix as a low bed

fade_in.note: avoids a hard attack at frame 0; sits under the visual emergence

fade_out.note: starts 0.2s ahead of the 8.8s visual beat because audio decay reads slower than visual fade - both land together by 9.9s

audio.character: subtle dark ambient pads, no drums, ~70 BPM minor; 30.0s WAV (12s seed crossfade-looped), only the first 10.0s used
audio.playback: framework-owned <audio> per the HF contract; deterministic, no autoplay logic

scenes.motion: fade_blur entrance: the single all-caps lockup emerges opacity 0->1 + blur 14px->0 with per-word starts at 0.30/0.40/0.50s (1.9s each, power2.out), first glimmer landing on the 0.5s beat, readable by ~2.0s, sharp by 2.4s; letter-spacing settles 0.30em->0.22em over 0.3-2.6s (power3.out); hold_breath scale 1->1.015 across 2.6-8.8s (sine.inOut); pattern-interrupt on the 5.0s beat: underline_sweep - a 2px gradient hairline (transparent -> #8FA8C8 -> transparent, 60% lockup width) scales scaleX 0->1 from 4.90s over 0.9s (power3.out, origin left) - plus faint glow on ALLIANCE (textShadow 0 0 32px rgba(143,168,200,0.55), 0.8s yoyo, 5.0-6.6s); resolve on the 8.8s beat: fade_out of lockup + rule over 8.8-9.9s (power2.in), resting on the empty dark field to 10.0s
